params.apply_time_col: Application time field, default apply_time; must exist in the input table; the time_dims derivation depends on it

params.target_cols: Optional y labels; when empty, WOE, IV/KS, variable-level correlation details, and feature screening are skipped
params.new_feature_cols: List of new features; inferred automatically when empty
params.incumbent_feature_cols: List of old features; mainly used for the new vs incumbent correlation comparison

params.categorical_features: List of categorical variables; mainly affects the categorical handling of monotone WOE and the CSV batch base cols

params.input_type: auto/dataframe/csv; auto decides from the type of run(data)
params.csv_read_kwargs: Parameters passed to pandas.read_csv; must not contain usecols or chunksize

params.enable_batch: Default false; feature batch mode is entered only when true and the input is a CSV

children.feature_batch_size: Split into a batch for every N features of new_feature_cols
children.feature_batches: Feature batches specified explicitly by the user; takes precedence over feature_batch_size

level2.name: Batching Constraints
rules: A CSV path must be the input when enable_batch=true

DataFrame input does not support batch

params.split_col: Recommended field; must contain ins/oos, oot is optional, and other values such as ft_oot are kept as extra evaluation sets; highest priority
params.sample_col: Compatible legacy parameter, default sample_ind; used when split_col is empty
params.oot_col: Optional OOT flag; used when there is no split/sample field

split_config.stratify: Whether to stratify by target, default true
split_config.random_state: Split random seed; when empty, the top-level random_state is used

level2.name: Split Priority
rules: split_col first
split_col values are stripped and lowercased; custom evaluation sets take no part in the WOE fit or feature screening
Then sample_col
Then oot_col
Finally INS/OOS are split randomly by split_config

params.time_dims: Time dimensions, default apply_month; may include apply_week/apply_month/apply_quarter
params.population_dims: Population dimensions, such as channel and strategy_version

params.distribution_enabled: Whether to compute distributions, default true

distribution_params.feature_block_size: Feature-column block size for wide-table distribution statistics, default 128

level2.name: Dependencies
rules: By default only new_feature_cols are analyzed
Grouping depends on time_dims, population_dims, and group_specs

level2.name: WOE Master Switch

params.woe_enabled: Whether to run WOE, default true
params.woe_fit_query: Filter condition applied to the INS training sample before the WOE fit
params.woe_plot_groups: Which groups to output the WOE by-group plots for

rules: Runs only when target_cols is non-empty
Each target_col is fitted separately
Only INS samples with a non-null target are used for the fit

woe_params.sv_min_bin_size: 0.8.0 SV bin share threshold [0.0,1.0), default 0.0 = off
woe_params.sv_small_policy: 0.8.0 keep (default)/neutral/merge_missing, fallback for sub-threshold SV bins
woe_params.sv_woe_smoothing: 0.8.0 none (default)/laplace, bad-rate shrinkage of SV bin WOE

monotone_woe_params.sv_min_bin_size: 0.8.0 SV bin share threshold [0.0,1.0), default 0.0 = off
monotone_woe_params.sv_small_policy: 0.8.0 keep (default)/neutral/merge_missing, fallback for sub-threshold SV bins
monotone_woe_params.sv_woe_smoothing: 0.8.0 none (default)/laplace, bad-rate shrinkage of SV bin WOE
monotone_woe_params.unseen_special_policy: 0.8.2 normal_bin (default)/neutral; numeric special values declared but absent from the fit sample: binned as ordinary values / a placeholder bin takes missing_woe

children.monotone_refine_cate_enabled: Whether to call refine_cate on categorical_features

params.woe_fit_scope: "post_missing_gate" (default since 0.7.0) or "all": first run the missing_rate_threshold missing-rate gate and then fit the top-level WOE, to keep a single high-missing feature from dragging down the whole target's WOE artifacts; an explicit all keeps the old basis

level2.name: monotone Binning Governance (G08/G09/G17, passed through via monotone_woe_params)

params.min_bad_count: Minimum number of bad samples in an ordinary bin; None (default) means no check
params.min_good_count: Minimum number of good samples in an ordinary bin; None (default) means no check
params.small_bin_policy: merge/warn/raise; None (default) turns small-bin governance off
params.reference_target: Derives the expected direction of each feature from the point-biserial sign of the reference label
params.direction_conflict_policy: warn/raise/keep; how to handle an actual WOE that violates a fixed direction
params.missing_bin_strategy: empirical_special/fixed_woe/fail; None (default) derives it from special_values
params.refine_min_n_bins_policy: warn/enforce/raise; how to handle a refine_dtree result whose bin count falls below min_n_bins, default warn since 0.7.0; an explicit null turns this governance off

level2.name: Low-Share Special-Value Governance (SV Bin Governance, 0.8.0, passed through via woe_params / monotone_woe_params)

params.sv_min_bin_size: SV bin share threshold [0.0,1.0); prop = n_bin / N_total (no eps added to the denominator), triggers only when strictly below; 0.0 (default) = off
params.sv_small_policy: keep (default, old behavior)/neutral (WOE=IV=0)/merge_missing (counts merged into [Missing] and recomputed, the stored WOE of merged rows rewritten to the [Missing] WOE and IV set to 0; when there is no [Missing] bin it degrades to neutral with a warning)
params.sv_woe_smoothing: none (default)/laplace; laplace uses bad-rate shrinkage r=(n_bad+α·p)/(n_bin+α) and then converts back to shares, applying only to SV bins
params.sv_smoothing_alpha: Smoothing strength α>=0; 0.0 (default) is bit-for-bit equivalent to the old empirical WOE, and as α→∞ the WOE shrinks monotonically to 0, with stronger shrinkage the smaller the bin

rules: Governs only special-value bins (including [Missing]); ordinary interval bins are completely unaffected
Mode 1 (fallback) takes priority over Mode 2 (smoothing): a sub-threshold bin that goes through neutral/merge_missing is not smoothed afterward
When merge_missing + laplace are both on, the merge-target [Missing] bin is recomputed by the empirical formula, unsmoothed; other qualifying SV bins are still smoothed
The [Missing] bin is itself a governed SV bin, with the only special trait that it can be only a merge target, not a merge source
The default combination of the four parameters is bit-for-bit identical to 0.7.2, so upgrading does not change existing outputs; illegal values raise ValueError at the entry
The monotone branch of FVP is filtered by the _MONOTONE_INIT_KEYS allowlist, and the four sv_* keys are on the list; keys not on the list are silently dropped (no error)
sv_* are constructor parameters and must not be added to _MONOTONE_FIT_KEYS ({chi2_binning, chi2_p, chi2_init_size, n_jobs}), otherwise a TypeError is raised
config_snapshot dumps woe_params / monotone_woe_params verbatim, so sv_* automatically enters the snapshot and is available for reproducibility audits

params.psi_use_woe_bins: Whether to reuse the WOE bin boundaries, default true

level2.name: Dependencies
rules: When psi_use_woe_bins=true, it depends on the binning engine produced successfully by WOE
If there is no reusable WOE engine, it falls back to PSICalculator's own binning
time/population grouping depends on time_dims/population_dims

params.ivks_enabled: Whether to compute IV/KS, default true

Computed separately for each target_col
Only samples with a non-null target are used

params.ivks_use_woe_bins: Whether to reuse the WOE bin boundaries, default true

level2.name: Selection Switches

params.selection_enabled: Whether to run the comprehensive feature selection, default false
params.missing_rate_threshold: Missing-rate threshold; used when selection_params does not override it
params.weight_col: Sample-weight field for the screening stage

rules: Runs only when target_cols is non-empty
Only target_cols[0] is used as the screening target
If weight_col is configured, it must exist in the INS split
String categories in categorical_features compute the weighted missing rate by non-null state, without being forced to float

level2.name: Post-Selection Gates (G02–G06, third-level parameters of selection_params)

params.iv_upper_threshold: IV upper limit; exceeding it is treated as suspected label leakage and eliminated (reason=iv_above_upper)
params.monthly_iv_min: Lower limit of the group (e.g. monthly) IV; requires selection_group_dims
params.monthly_iv_cv_max: Upper limit of the group-IV coefficient of variation; requires selection_group_dims
params.direction_consistency_min: Lower limit of the share of groups whose direction agrees with the mode; requires selection_group_dims
params.min_group_n: Minimum number of samples in a group for the group-stability gate; falls back to min_group_size by default
params.insufficient_group_policy: keep_warn (default)/drop/raise; how to handle fewer than 2 qualifying groups
params.min_pass_count: Minimum number of passing labels when target_rules=min_pass_count
params.per_target_iv_range: (low, high) or {target: (low, high)}; per-label IV range
params.direction_reference_target: Direction reference label; the directions of the other labels must agree with it
params.max_selected_features: Hard upper limit on the number of selected features; truncated by IV ranking, ties broken by name
params.min_selected_features: Lower limit; falling short only warns and does not backfill (keeping the gate's causal auditability)
params.vif_enabled: VIF gate switch (default False); requires the optional dependency SuperModelingFactory[stats]
params.vif_threshold: VIF threshold (default 10.0); the feature with the largest VIF is removed iteratively
params.vif_min_features: Lower limit on features kept by the VIF iteration (default 2)
params.vif_use_woe_bins: Default false: only raw numeric columns enter VIF, and non-numeric columns are kept and written to the audit; true: use the WOE-encoded INS matrix. When categorical_features is declared, woe_engine=monotone is required, and equal_freq raises an explicit error

params.selection_group_dims: Grouping dimensions for the group-stability gate evidence (e.g. ['apply_month']); configuring group-stability thresholds without dimensions raises a loud error

monotone_woe_params.pipeline_note: FeatureValidationPipeline._fit_monotone_binner first filters monotone_woe_params with the _MONOTONE_INIT_KEYS allowlist and then passes them to the constructor: init_params = {k: v for k, v in params.items() if k in self._MONOTONE_INIT_KEYS}. Keys not on the allowlist are silently dropped (no error, no warning). The four sv_* keys have been added to _MONOTONE_INIT_KEYS and also to Feature_Screen._MONOTONE_INIT_KEYS (the WOE fit reused at screening time goes through that one, and missing it would split the screening IV and the modeling WOE onto different bases). From now on, any new parameter added to MonotoneWOEBinner.__init__ must be added to both allowlists; sv_* are constructor parameters and must not be added to _MONOTONE_FIT_KEYS.
